subject.title: Session reset on abort settle timeout causes complete context loss (session amnesia)

question: Should OpenClaw automatically carry bounded prior-session context into replacement sessions after provider-error abort/takeover, and what auth, channel, thread, and reset-reason boundaries must gate it?
rationale: Current main has partial replay machinery, but applying it to abort/takeover recovery changes session continuity and sensitive transcript exposure semantics that code inspection cannot choose safely.

options.title: Bounded same-conversation replay
options.body: Carry only a small user/assistant tail into replacement sessions when the session key, auth owner, channel, thread, and reset reason all match.

options.title: Resend guidance only
options.body: Avoid automatic context carry-forward and surface clear recovery guidance when takeover interrupts a provider-error turn.

options.title: Defer to memory design
options.body: Leave this issue open until a cross-session memory or trajectory indexing policy owns summary injection and retrieval.

recommendation.title: Bounded same-conversation replay
recommendation.body: Carry only a small user/assistant tail into replacement sessions when the session key, auth owner, channel, thread, and reset reason all match.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this account to session/fallback policy work and the affected runtime boundaries, making it the best available decision owner from the sampled history.
